functions.name: scanUtf8CodePoints
functions.signature: (type $t10) (param i32 i32 i32 i32 i32) (result i32)
functions.notes: Counts bytes covered by up to budget complete UTF-8 code points from start to end; invalid/truncated sequences are not consumed. Code-point sibling of 483.

validation.comparison: All 256 single bytes, lead/continuation class cross-products, every prefix, budgets and 200 random strings compare return, complete memory and stack pointer.
limitations: Out-of-bounds pointers and cursor beyond end are not enumerated.
Ledger: 253 server bodies recovered and 481 remain machine code.
